description.value: Remote BC Parks campground on the shores of large, wild Morice Lake, reached by a long gravel forest service road out of Houston; no confirmed amenities on record, so self-sufficiency is essential.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website loaded but returned only site-wide navigation content with no Morice Lake-specific amenity details; all subpages returned 404. OSM tags are the primary evidence: tourism=camp_site, operator=BC Parks, capacity=18, fee=no, internet_access=no. Because the website provided no amenity specifics, all optional amenities must be null except where OSM explicitly states a value (internet_access=no).
concerns: Website loaded only site-wide navigation content with no Morice Lake-specific amenity information; all subpages returned 404, severely limiting evidence for optional amenities.
No address or phone number available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open BC Parks campground with 18 sites and no fee; a genuine and useful stop for touring cyclists in a remote region.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag fee=no confirmed; internet_access=no confirmed by OSM tag. All optional amenities unverifiable due to lack of park-specific content on the website.
